name: config-variable-table
goal: Configs lists only variable names and their source values at the selected revision.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Configs must show exactly Variable and Value columns, one row per source setting at the selected revision, with working search and detail links.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: Existing explorer-catalog-screen test asserts module names and table markup only; entity-preview-groups checks grouping only; unit-metadata tests omit config initializer values. Extend these standardized suites for source values, history, columns, search, and navigation.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Committed metadata regression fails for missing configValues. Browser matrix fails expected two-column assertion at all three widths, with pre-assertion screenshots.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Source-derived config metadata feeds variable rows and two-column ExplorerTable; variable search and owning-entity links remain revision scoped.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
